scope: Actual B/S load cell with 1.4 kg rigid S downstream, exact gravity tare and a calibrated measurement model; 50 N, 90 degrees, the sharp bump. Noise/controller covariance and stated sensing/drive latency are screened; this is not full-range qualification.
robotTravelMeasurement: Modeled noisy/delayed magnet measurement supplied to both fast force control and slow robot recentering.
loadCellAssumption: Fcell_tared = true contact force - 1.4 kg * S acceleration; acceleration appears in sensor physics only and in the observer estimated measurement equation, never as a controller truth input.
